node.statement: Since rho_Upsilon' <= rho_Delta, lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness gives ||Delta-tilde-Delta||_cb <= C_Delta*eta; lem-routef-upsilon-prime-component-construction gives ||Upsilon'||_cb <= 1; and lem-routef-upsilon-prime-left-inverse gives ||Upsilon' Delta-I_B||_cb <= C_L*eta. Therefore ||Upsilon' tilde-Delta-I_B||_cb <= (C_Delta+C_L)*eta.
